name: How much does interior window trim installation cost?

mainEntity.name: How much does interior window trim installation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of interior window trim installation depends on several factors, including the type of material chosen (e.g., MDF, pine, oak), the complexity of the trim profile, the number of windows, and whether old trim removal is required. Premium wood types and custom profiles will typically increase the overall cost compared to standard MDF options. We provide detailed estimates tailored to your project after an initial assessment, ensuring transparency for our clients in Star and surrounding areas.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cost varies based on material, trim complexity, number of windows, and old trim removal. Premium materials typically cost more.
